_doc: Capability registry. A task's needs must be a subset of an agent's capabilities for nexus.py to offer it. Strengths are starting guesses (2026-11-26); ledger/outcomes.jsonl replaces guesses with data once an agent has 3+ recorded tasks.

capabilities.shell: runs commands in a sandbox (git, python, tests)
capabilities.godot-headless: can install and run Godot 4.7.2 headless: tools/test.sh, autoplay, Eyes
capabilities.git-push: pushes branches and opens PRs on Duff's repos
capabilities.github-api: reads/writes GitHub through an API connector without a shell
capabilities.review: can act as a fresh-context reviewer on a PR diff
capabilities.art-direction: writes art prompts and judges art against the style guide
capabilities.web-research: searches and reads the live web
capabilities.long-context: reads very large inputs in one pass (whole repos, long logs)
capabilities.writing: player-facing copy, store pages, marketing posts
capabilities.phone-only-ok: Duff can run it from his Android phone

agents.name: Claude Code (cloud session)
agents.strengths: multi-file code + tests in Godot repos, running the real game headless, audits, Foxboard artifact

agents.name: OpenAI Codex (cloud task)
agents.strengths: well-scoped implementation tasks with a clear done_when; second-opinion reviews

agents.name: ChatGPT app
agents.strengths: image generation, copy, research; reviews from a pasted diff or the GitHub connector

agents.name: Grok
agents.strengths: art (grok_art/ pipelines in the game repos), fresh-eyes review of a PR diff

agents.name: Gemini app
agents.strengths: backgrounds/art runs (Drive folder pipeline), very long documents

agents.name: GitHub Copilot coding agent
agents.strengths: small issue-sized fixes assigned from GitHub; not yet used in the studio

agents.name: Duff (human)
agents.strengths: approvals (duff-ok, art OKs), phone playtests, merges where a repo needs him
